t: What Sodium-Ion Battery Storage Grid Is
title: What Sodium-Ion Battery Storage Grid Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Sodium-ion battery storage grids are grid-scale energy storage built on sodium-ion chemistry: abundant, cheap sodium replaces lithium, delivering the economics for storing solar and wind at the terawatt-hour scale the energy transition needs. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Sodium-Ion Battery Storage Grid: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Sodium-Ion Battery Storage Grid in one line: Sodium-ion battery storage grids are grid-scale energy storage built on sodium-ion chemistry: abundant, cheap sodium replaces lithium, delivering the economics for storing solar and wind at the terawatt-hour scale the energy transition needs.
Why it matters: Sodium is 1000x more abundant than lithium — the chemistry for grid storage that can scale without resource wars..
Where it is used: grid-scale renewable storage, peaker replacement, microgrids, backup power..

t: Current Research State of Sodium-Ion Battery Storage Grid
